subject: Activation window: staffing swap and doc escort plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Simon Lewis <simon.lewis@acme.ai>
Cc: Acme Cloud Eng Ops <eng-ops@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation window: staffing swap and doc escort plan

Team —

Heads-up on scope for the April activation window (target: week of Apr 9). There are two open items we need to lock before I brief execs next Wednesday: staffing coverage for the first 72 hours, and a clear doc "escort" plan so ACME engineering can self-serve when we pause traffic to run the KV-cache migration.

Proposed quick plan:
- Marcus: own on-call rotation / canary decision tree (I put a suggested rota in the attached staffing_matrix_q2.xlsx).
- Kimberly: own the runbook + docs triage; I attached activation_runbook_v0.9.md — it's a draft but contains step-by-step rollback and runbook tasks.
- Grace: own enablement (two 30-minute run-throughs for Acme SREs + one internal dry-run).
- Hannah: ops point for infra prechecks and emergency rollback exec (page role).

Questions I have for the group before I lock this:
1) Are the proposed owners workable? Any conflicts Apr 9–12?
2) Can Kimberly produce a hero-level TL;DR <1 page for Acme and a longer runbook for oncall by Apr 3?
3) Marcus — how many canaries do you need to validate rollback within an hour (1x, 3x)?

Simon — adding you so Acme knows who we'll lean on. We want to avoid surprise pages the first night.

Attachments: activation_runbook_v0.9.md (staged), staffing_matrix_q2.xlsx (rota + backups)

Next step: please reply with owner confirmations and any blocking constraints by EOD Thu (Mar 29). If I don't hear blockers, I'll lock owners and publish the final runbook on Fri.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Program Manager, Product
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Simon Lewis <simon.lewis@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation window: staffing swap and doc escort plan

Marissa — thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers inline below.

On Wed, 28 Mar 2028 at 09:12, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marcus: own on-call rotation / canary decision tree (I put a suggested rota in the attached staffing_matrix_q2.xlsx).

I can take rotation ownership with the following caveats:
- I need two backups (one infra, one runtime) in the first 48h in case of multi-node incidents. The spreadsheet's backups column looks fine but I'll email names by Thu morning.
- For canaries: propose 3 progressive canaries (1%, 10%, 30%) with 30–60 minute observation windows between steps. That gives us fast signal without blocking the activation window.

Questions for Kimberly: can the runbook include an explicit checklist for the canary gating signals (SLO delta, error-rate delta, p95 increase)? I want hard thresholds we can follow under pressure.

I'll also add a short escalation matrix to the runbook and drop a link once it's in the shared folder.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Release Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

I can do two slots next week: Apr 3 @ 10:00 PT (internal dry-run) and Apr 5 @ 09:30 PT (customer-facing run-through).

Kimberly — I'll need the one-page TL;DR by Apr 2 EOD so I can build the 30-min slide deck and the live demo checklist. Also, let's schedule a 30-min rehearsal Apr 4 so we avoid surprises.

Grace

Thanks all — consolidating action items and timeline below (publishing final runbook + rota Fri morning):

Action items:
- Marcus: send final rota + escalation matrix by Thu Mar 30 EOD (note: Marcus sent a draft in thread; final expected by EOD).
- Kimberly: produce TL;DR (1 page) by Apr 2 EOD and update activation_runbook with explicit canary gating thresholds by Apr 3.
- Grace: confirm enablement slots (Apr 3 internal; Apr 5 customer) and run rehearsal on Apr 4.
- Hannah: run infra prechecks checklist Apr 8 and confirm node capacity for cold-starts.
- Marissa: publish final runbook + links to the shared folder Fri morning and notify Simon.

Shared folder and live links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-release-escort-runbook
HubSpot reference: HUBSPOT-123456

Simon — welcome feedback from Acme on the canary cadence. If you want a different cadence we can discuss Thu.

If no blockers by EOD Fri I'll mark owners as locked and send the final communication to execs.
